# Archguard

> Archguard applies configured policies to selected source files and their resolved dependencies. It also checks file conventions and provides duplication review and mutation testing tools. Use the examples as starting points and review their scope on your repository.

## Compare existing coverage

Review the rules and plugins already enabled in your linter and dependency-analysis tools. Archguard examples cover transitive dependency restrictions, package entry points and dependencies, specified calls, file roles, companion files, static registry imports, custom graph policies, structural similarity, and mutation testing. Some checks overlap with existing tools; evaluate which policies fit your repository's conventions.

## Contracts

For archguard check, exit 0 means complete selected analysis with no policy findings. Exit 1 means complete analysis with rule violations. Exit 2 means incomplete analysis or invalid configuration. Selectors never add files to discovery. Archguard runs only plugin and provider commands that are explicitly configured. Duplicate and mutation reports exit 0 when complete, even with findings.

## Start

- [Evaluate a repository with an agent](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/docs/guides/evaluate.md): install the irudd-ts-evaluate skill and give it a time and disk budget.
- [README: build and first check](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/README.md)
- [Full reference](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/docs/README.md): configuration, file selection, import resolution, every rule kind, plugins, compiler member checks, caching.
- [Every rule kind](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/docs/guides/rules.md) and [repository rules](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/docs/guides/repository-rules.md)
- [Examples as JSON](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples.json)

## Examples

- [Keep server code out of the client](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/block-server/index.md): Report a configured restriction when client code reaches a server module through a shared module.
- [Make other code use a package's public entry](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/public-entry/index.md): Stop code from reaching into a workspace package's private files.
- [Restrict a package dependency](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/package-dependencies/index.md): Report React dependencies in a selected domain package's manifest.
- [Report specified calls in dependencies](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/block-calls/index.md): Report a dependency path to a module containing an Effect.runPromise call.
- [Enforce a team import convention](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/service-namespace/index.md): Require namespace imports for Effect service modules.
- [Check configured file roles](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/classify-files/index.md): Report analyzed files that do not match the configured roles.
- [Require a companion file](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/companions/index.md): Check that each selected service has a corresponding analyzed layer file.
- [Require static imports for migration files](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/registry-imports/index.md): Check that a configured registry statically imports each selected migration file.
- [Write a policy over the analyzed graph](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/typescript-plugin/index.md): Plugins get the same resolved graph as the built-in rules. This one does the client-to-server check by hand.
- [Review similar functions](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/find-duplicates/index.md): Group selected functions by structural similarity.
- [Review edits that survive your tests](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/run-mutations/index.md): Run selected tests against small edits, such as changing >= to >, in isolated copies.
- [Evaluate checks with an agent](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/agent-evaluation/index.md): Review candidate policies, structural matches, and mutation results within a time and disk budget.
